edits.before: Luden's onward, hunt the skirmishes — but never recast R while drowsy: sleep catches you mid-dash and doubles the wake-up hit. Dash in clean.
edits.after: Luden's onward, hunt the skirmishes — but never recast R (140s) while drowsy: sleep catches you mid-dash and doubles the wake-up hit. Dash in clean.

notes: breakdown.mid: 'doubles the wake-up hit' is supported by Riot's Sleepy Trouble Bubble text ('first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap'); added the R 140s number to make the field concrete.
